site.name: weaveapi
site.summary: weaveapi-clone Fictional payments API platform "WeaveAPI" developer docs (Stripe-style). Pages (shared docs three-column layout: left nav / center body / right try-it or anchors) | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Docs home: Quickstart, Authentication, Idempotency, Pagination, Errors sections + Popular guides 4 cards | | `quickstart.html` | Install + first-charge two-step example | | `charges.html` | Charges API: Charge object 18-field table + 5 endpoint sections (POST create / GET single / capture / refund / list), each section with parameter table + multi-lang code block + JSON response example; right-column try-it panel syncs with the current endpoint as you scroll, fill params + Send returns a mock response (`currency=usd/eur/gbp/jpy` returns a charge object, anything else returns `currency_not_supported`) |

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore the core docs/tutorial flow for WeaveAPI, with emphasis on the Quickstart-to-Charges onboarding path, adjacent reference pages, and validation of interactive code samples, right-rail try-it behavior, and mobile usability issues.
run_plan.summary: Start on the docs home and Quickstart flow to confirm the primary onboarding story, then branch into the full Charges and Customers references, where most interactive controls and validation risk live. Use Errors and Webhooks to cover recovery, signatures, and event semantics, and verify that code tabs, copy controls, anchor navigation, and the Charges try-it panel behave consistently. Repeat the critical navigation and interaction checks in mobile viewport, prioritizing tap target and horizontal overflow issues already indicated by prescan.
assumptions: The site is a static docs/tutorial clone with shared left navigation, center content, and right rail; there is no authenticated app state or server-side mutation beyond mock/demo interactions.
The visible buttons labeled CURL/PYTHON/NODE/GO and Copy are meaningful interactive controls across pages and should be tested for state changes or content updates.
The Charges page contains the highest-risk interactive surface because it includes multiple endpoint sections plus a synchronized try-it panel with mock responses.
The search field may be present sitewide but its behavior is not yet confirmed; it should be checked as a lightweight utility control rather than assumed to support rich search results.
risk_hotspots: charges.html: endpoint sections + synchronized right-rail try-it panel + parameter validation/mocked response behavior
charges.html and customers.html: horizontally dense tables/code blocks causing overflow on smaller screens
index.html, quickstart.html, errors.html, webhooks.html: small left-nav tap targets and anchor navigation on mobile
webhooks.html: signature verification and retry guidance, which are common comprehension and recovery-risk areas
errors.html: structured error codes and handling guidance, especially for payment failures and 3DS-related flows

phases.title: Orient on docs home and primary onboarding
phases.objective: Validate the landing page hierarchy, the onboarding narrative, and the main navigation paths into the docs.
key_checks: Confirm the home page presents the expected core sections: Quickstart, Authentication, Idempotency, Pagination, Errors, and Popular guides.
Open Quickstart from the left nav and verify the two-step getting-started flow is coherent and easy to follow.
Test the code sample controls on home/quickstart, including language tabs and Copy behavior if available.
Confirm that primary guide links from the home page lead to the intended adjacent pages.
exit_criteria: Home page and Quickstart have been visited in desktop view, with the main sections and guide links confirmed.
At least one code sample interaction and one navigation transition from the landing page have been validated.

phases.title: Validate core API reference on Charges
phases.objective: Exercise the most feature-rich page, including object reference, endpoint sections, and the try-it panel.
key_checks: Review the Charge object table for clarity, field naming, and scannability.
Step through each endpoint section: create, retrieve, capture, refund, and list.
Interact with the endpoint code blocks and any tabs/buttons to ensure the visible snippet matches the selected language/state.
Use the try-it panel for the create-charge flow, vary currency among supported values, and confirm supported vs unsupported behavior.
Verify that endpoint scrolling keeps the right-rail try-it panel synchronized to the current section.
exit_criteria: All five Charges endpoint sections have been reached or scrolled through.
At least one supported mock response and one unsupported currency/error response have been observed in the try-it panel.
Code sample controls and the sync behavior of the right rail have been checked.

phases.title: Cover adjacent resource management flow
phases.objective: Validate customer lifecycle docs as the main adjacent flow to charges, focusing on data model and CRUD navigation.
key_checks: Review the Customer object table for completeness and readability.
Open each CRUD section: create, retrieve, update, delete, and list.
Check whether code tabs and copy actions behave consistently with Charges.
Look for any page-width or table overflow issues in desktop and mobile layouts.
exit_criteria: Customer object and all CRUD sections have been inspected.
Any visible overflow or alignment issues have been confirmed or ruled out in at least one viewport.

phases.title: Validate failure and recovery guidance
phases.objective: Check how the docs explain errors, retries, and webhook verification for real-world integration recovery.
key_checks: Review the error code table for severity, messages, and handling advice.
Confirm that the page surfaces key payment-failure cases such as card_declined, insufficient_funds, processing_error, fraud_blocked, and 3DS-required handling.
On Webhooks, inspect event type coverage and verify the sections for signing and retries.
Test anchor navigation to page sections from the left nav and on-page right rail where present.
Confirm code sample/tab behavior on these pages if interactive snippets are shown.
exit_criteria: The error reference and webhook guidance have each been opened and the main section structure verified.
At least one or two section anchors on Webhooks have been used successfully.

phases.title: Mobile viewport regression pass
phases.objective: Repeat the most important navigation and interaction checks on mobile to catch tap target, overflow, and sticky-rail issues.
key_checks: Verify that left-nav items remain usable despite the prescan's small-tap-target warnings.
Check whether horizontal overflow appears on Charges, Customers, and Webhooks in mobile width.
Retest the Quickstart and Charges code sample controls, plus the Charges try-it panel if it remains accessible.
Confirm that anchor-based navigation still lands on the intended section when using the mobile viewport.
exit_criteria: All known pages have at least a lightweight mobile pass, with emphasis on the high-risk pages.
The run has recorded whether the known tap-target and overflow issues are present or only desktop artifacts.

coverage_targets.pages: visit all known HTML pages: index.html, quickstart.html, charges.html, customers.html, errors.html, webhooks.html
coverage_targets.features: exercise the visible navigation, section anchors, code language tabs, Copy actions, and the Charges try-it panel; inspect the main reference tables on Charges, Customers, and Errors
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat the primary onboarding path and the Charges/Customers/Webhooks risk checks in mobile viewport, with explicit attention to small tap targets and horizontal overflow

notes: Do not assume search exposes global results or advanced filtering unless interaction proves it.
Prioritize Charges over other pages if step budget tightens, since it has the richest and riskiest interaction model.

prescan_summary.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https:
headings: Accept your first payment in 5 minutes.

prescan_summary.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url

prescan_summary.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.

observation.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO from weave import Weave client = Weave("sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") charge = client.charges.create( amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa", description="UXBench demo charge", ) print(charge.id, charge.status) Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client = Weave(api_key="sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") Copy Idempotency Every state-changing request accepts an Idempotency-Key header. Retry safely: a retry with the same key returns the original response, even if your client retried after a timeout. Pagination List endpoints use cursor-based pagination. has_more tells you when you've reached the end; next_cursor is the opaque token for the next page. Errors WeaveAPI returns conventional HTTP status codes plus a structured error object with type, code, and message. Full list → Popular guides Charges API → Create, capture, list, refund. Customers API → Save methods, manage profiles. Webhooks → Listen for events, sign requests. Error reference → 25+ error codes with hints. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.paid Invoice transitioned to paid invoice.payment_failed Charge attempt failed for invoice subscription.created New subscription subscription.updated Plan / quantity / proration change subscription.canceled Subscription ended Verifying signatures Each webhook includes a WeaveAPI-Signature header: t=<unix-ts>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>. Recompute the HMAC over "<t>.<body>" using your webhook signing secret and constant-time compare. CURL PYTHON NODE GO import hmac, hashlib, time def verify(payload, header, secret, tolerance=300): ts, sig = [p.split("=")[1] for p in header.split(",")] if abs(time.time() - int(ts)) > tolerance: raise ValueError("expired") expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), f"{ts}.{payload}".encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest() if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, sig): raise ValueError("bad signature") Copy Retries We retry non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours (max 24 attempts). Respond with 200 as soon as the event is enqueued — don't block on heavy work in the request handler. ON THIS PAGE Event types Verifying signatures Retries

observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url currency_not_supported 400 Currency not enabled on account Enable currency in dashboard amount_too_small 400 Below minimum charge amount Increase amount (min $0.50 USD) amount_too_large 400 Above per-transaction maximum Split the charge missing_required_param 400 Required parameter omitted Check the error param invalid_param 400 Parameter value was invalid See param and message resource_missing 404 No such resource Check the ID resource_already_exists 409 Duplicate idempotency key with different params Use a new idempotency key authentication_required 401 Missing or invalid API key Send Authorization: Bearer sk_… permission_denied 403 API key lacks scope Grant scope in dashboard rate_limited 429 Too many requests Back off; respect Retry-After account_inactive 403 Account is closed or suspended Contact support refund_too_large 400 Refund exceeds refundable amount Check amount_refunded charge_already_captured 400 Charge was already captured No action needed charge_already_refunded 400 Charge fully refunded No action needed customer_max_payment_methods 400 Cannot attach more methods (limit 25) Detach unused methods idempotency_key_in_use 409 Key in use for in-flight request Wait and retry the same key invalid_webhook_signature 400 Webhook HMAC didn't match Check signing secret service_unavailable 503 Temporary outage Retry with backoff; check status page

observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. Recent (last 3)

observation.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url currency_not_supported 400 Currency not enabled on account Enable currency in dashboard amount_too_small 400 Below minimum charge amount Increase amount (min $0.50 USD) amount_too_large 400 Above per-transaction maximum Split the charge missing_required_param 400 Required parameter omitted Check the error param invalid_param 400 Parameter value was invalid See param and message resource_missing 404 No such resource Check the ID resource_already_exists 409 Duplicate idempotency key with different params Use a new idempotency key authentication_required 401 Missing or invalid API key Send Authorization: Bearer sk_… permission_denied 403 API key lacks scope Grant scope in dashboard rate_limited 429 Too many requests Back off; respect Retry-After account_inactive 403 Account is closed or suspended Contact support refund_too_large 400 Refund exceeds refundable amount Check amount_refunded charge_already_captured 400 Charge was already captured No action needed charge_already_refunded 400 Charge fully refunded No action needed customer_max_payment_methods 400 Cannot attach more methods (limit 25) Detach unused methods idempotency_key_in_use 409 Key in use for in-flight request Wait and retry the same key invalid_webhook_signature 400 Webhook HMAC didn't match Check signing secret service_unavailable 503 Temporary outage Retry with backoff; check status page

observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.create({ amount: 2000, currency: "usd", paymentMethod: "pm_card_visa" }); Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.create({ amount: 2000, currency: "usd", paymentMethod: "pm_card_visa" }); Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/capture -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=1500 Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/refund -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=500 Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl "https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges?customer=cus_abc&limit=10" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.create({ amount: 2000, currency: "usd", paymentMethod: "pm_card_visa" }); Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB"); Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", { amount: 1500 }); Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", { amount: 500 }); Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.list({ customer: "cus_abc", limit: 10 }); Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response { "id": "ch_kck5xx81ah", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "created": 1778844058, "livemode": false } Recent (last 3)

observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.create({ amount: 2000, currency: "usd", paymentMethod: "pm_card_visa" }); Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB"); Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", { amount: 1500 }); Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", { amount: 500 }); Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO await weave.charges.list({ customer: "cus_abc", limit: 10 }); Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy

observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy
